name: Youth Innovation Program (WIOA In-School Youth)
what_you_do: You get help getting into college and jobs. You also get help with work-based learning, such as internships and apprenticeships. You get mentoring and support services.
grades: Currently in high school or college
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 21, currently in high school or college. Alameda County program. No income or residency rule is listed on the page.
pay_detail: Not stated. The youth page mentions paid and unpaid work experience but gives no wage.
deadline_text: The page does not state an application window or ongoing intake.
how_to_apply: Call the Alameda County Workforce Development Board main line at (510) 259-3842. You can also use the Contact Us link on the youth page.
notes: Out-of-school youth ages 16 to 24 use the Future Force program instead. The youth page says to find a local Future Force provider through its Future Force page. The youth page lists no individual provider phone numbers.
